item.summary: Swedish company GreenMerc says unauthorised parties gained access to customer data at its Finnish crypto subsidiary NorthCrypto through a vulnerability in a third-party reporting tool, and that personal data may have been exposed. According to the company, crypto keys were not affected, and one unauthorised withdrawal was caused by human error; the customer will be compensated.
